request.prompt:
One real photograph of a classroom whiteboard calendar for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Photorealistic board, frame and marker ink; NOT an illustration, 3D render, screenshot or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no extra frames, padding, watermark or captions. The only writing is the calendar's own numbers: no letters, no words, no day names and no month names anywhere.

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph after someone drew on the board with a pen. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 is a photograph of a whiteboard month calendar. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same framing, the same board and wooden frame, the header, every date number from 1 to 31 in the same place, every small drawing and every existing mark. Do not move, redraw, add or remove any number. Add only this, drawn by hand with the same dark-blue whiteboard pen, with slightly uneven ink like real handwriting: one short, thick, curved ARROW that starts on the right edge of the existing blue loop around box 3 and points into the next box, box 4, with a clear arrowhead that ends inside box 4 beside its number. The arrow says: after the looped day comes this day. Do not draw a loop around box 4 and do not add any other mark.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
